data.action: 坐在靠窗桌边的轮椅上，捧着精致圣代笑意盈盈
data.description: 【蕾缪安 · 甜品店】装潢雅致的拉特兰露天甜品店内，蕾缪安坐在轮椅上，双手捧着点缀着金箔与草莓的高级特制圣代，嘴角噙着温柔满足的笑意——「拉特兰人对甜食的执着可是铭刻在源石律法里的哦。来，张开嘴，尝尝这一口香草奶油冰淇淋。」
data.promptProse: By the dessert-shop window, Lemuen sits in her wheelchair and supports a strawberry sundae crowned with gold leaf in both hands, smiling contentedly. Cream ribbed turtleneck with rolled sleeves and beige apple-emblem baking apron retain her current outfit. The medium close-up includes the glass dessert and pastry case behind the chair. Warm shop light catches gold leaf and sweater ribs, while softer window reflections illuminate the glass and leave pastry-case shelves gently shaded.
data.title: 蕾缪安 · 甜品店
